title: The Blackpick King's Tomb
rumor: The Blackpick King's Tomb. A dwarven family legend describes a richly furnished tomb concealed beneath a mountain shrine, containing the remains of a ruler who refused to abandon the ancient holds. The tomb's doors supposedly bear a warning that those who steal the king's possessions must return them before the third sunrise.
first_lead: Borin Blackpick has heard competing versions of the tale, though none identifies the ruler with certainty.
